create_multiagent_gym_env: create a MultiagentMobilityGymEnv instance with robot classes, scene, sensors, and tasks for locomotion simulation
reset_multiagent_env: reset the multiagent mobility gym environment to initial motor angles and rebuild the simulation world
step_multiagent_env: step the multiagent simulation forward with a dictionary of actions for all robots and return observations
render_multiagent_env: render the multiagent gym environment as an RGB array with a camera centered on robot positions
set_time_step: set the simulation time step and number of action repeats for the multiagent gym environment
